* Check all of your cards with ability, even the ones that cannot apply ability toward drawing battle destiny (e.g. starship passengers, characters affected by [[Wounded Warrior]], etc). If all of them are scouts and/or spies, adds one battle destiny and may perform the peek action.
* If with [[[Tatooine]]] [[Darth Maul]], setting Light's total ability = 0, Light would still check all their individual cards with ability there and if they are all scouts and/or spies, Cracken's text would still work.
